blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Stronger measures are needed to protect environmental defenders from attacks and address the land and resource conflicts that place communities at risk, Sen. Loren Legarda said in a statement on Tuesday, noting that Global Witness had documented 12 killings in the Philippines in 2025, the highest number recorded outside Latin America that year. “Environmental defenders” don’t refer only to activists. Those at risk can be farmers defending their land, indigenous communities protecting ancestral domains, or residents raising concerns about projects that may affect their water, livelihoods, forests, and communities. “No one should have to risk their life simply […]...
